decisions.reason: Metro data centre interconnection has demonstrated adoption by financial customers and sits at the core of the firm's high-bandwidth, data-centre-centric strategy, so performance meets aspirations and gives no reason for problemistic search.
Optical spectrum services monetise the owned fibre assets and match growing demand for high-capacity wavelengths, so the product is strategically central and likely above aspiration.

Carrier pre-selection is a shrinking legacy voice service in a declining-turnover industry with no visible results since launch, so it falls below aspiration and its resources are better redeployed to software-defined and cloud connectivity.
